newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Granite proposes 300 mln rgt rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Granite proposes 300 mln rgt rights issue.

text.p: Granite Industries Bhd said on Friday it has proposed a rights issue to raise at least 300 million ringgit ($113.3 million) to finance the expansion of its activities in northern Kedah state, the national Bernama news agency reported.
The company proposed a three-for-five rights issue of 133.800 million shares of 50 cents each at an offer price of 2.30 ringgit per share, said Bernama.

The rights issue is expected to raise 307.740 million ringgit, of which RM176.61 million will be used to finance the proposed subscription of shares in Langkasuka Resort Sdn Bhd, Langkawi Exhibition Hall Sdn Bhd and Aquabeat Langkawi Sdn Bhd.

Also, 60 million ringgit will be used to finance the construction of the Langkawi Airport Hotel and another 60 million ringgit will be utilised to finance the construction of the Paddy Museum near the northern town of Alor Setar.
The remaining proceeds will be set aside for working capital and to defray expenses in relation to the proposed rights issue.
Granite also said the rights issue is expected to to be completed in the first quarter of next year.
Upon completion of the rights issue, Granite Industries' issued and paid-up share capital will be increased to 356.8 million shares from 223 million shares currently.
